newsitem.title: USA: Tampa Electric 445 MW Fla. coal unit back.
newsitem.headline: Tampa Electric 445 MW Fla. coal unit back.

text.p: TECO Energy Inc's Tampa Electric Co said Monday its 445 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at its coal-fired Big Bend generating facility resumed operation following its autumn maintenance outage.

The company's 200 MW unit 4 and 245 MW unit 5, also coal-fired, at its Gannon power complex returned to service this past weekend after tripping off line a week ago for boiler tube leak repairs, a company spokesman said.
Both Gannon and Big Bend power plants are in Tampa, Fla.
Despite cold weather moving into Florida, the utility did not anticipate a spike in heating demand, the spokesman said.
"It doesn't look like our peak (load) is going to be particularly high today," he said.
